name: flickleaf
description: A browser reader where your hand controls the pace.

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:web
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist-chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename flickleaf-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
